description: OLE-TXN on a read/write copy: read the session properties Transaction DDL, Isolation Levels, Isolation Retention and Jet OLEDB:Transaction Commit Mode and the rowset properties Preserve on Commit and Preserve on Abort; hold a server keyset optimistic, a server forward-only and a client static Recordset; BeginTrans, edit and Update a row, CommitTrans, then read State, EOF, field values and MoveNext on each held Recordset; repeat with RollbackTrans; then set Attributes to adXactCommitRetaining|adXactAbortRetaining, BeginTrans, Update, CommitTrans and RollbackTrans again, reading Attributes, IsolationLevel and Errors. Asks the transaction level returned, whether held rowsets survive each transition and what the retaining attributes do.
